ubuntu-26.10.name: Ubuntu 26.10 Desktop (unattended, autoinstall)
ubuntu-26.10.notes: Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking Stingray, interim release of 2026-10-15): Ubuntu Server 26.10 autoinstall plus the ubuntu-desktop metapackage, the same recipe as ubuntu-26.04 (gdm3 autologin drop-in, the user in the autologin and nopasswdlogin groups, a ttyS0 getty, a post-install that asserts an active local graphical session). The interim releases live in ubuntu-interim.json, outside the LTS series of ubuntu-releases: nine months of support, then the next one replaces it. Live PASS 2026-10-16 in 10.5 min on the day after the release (kernel 7.3, GNOME Shell 51, systemd 261): the 26.04 recipe works unchanged, subiquity resolves ubuntu-desktop from autoinstall 'packages' and gdm3.service still answers as an alias of gdm.service.

runcmd: for dm in gdm3 gdm lightdm sddm; do systemctl list-unit-files "$dm.service" >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl enable "$dm" && break; done
groupadd -f autologin; groupadd -f nopasswdlogin; usermod -aG autologin,nopasswdlogin {{user}} || true
